title: Improving Reproducibility in Large Format Additive Manufacturing Using Recycled Pellets: A Design-Oriented Approach
content: Large format additive manufacturing using recycled plastic pellets marks a significant evolution in 3D printing, advancing both fabrication methods and circular economy goals. While it remains underutilized due to the inherent variability and unpredictability of the recycled material, difficult to manage in the context of product design and engineering, the experiences of New01Bike, Amarcord and OneLineTwoCoils show that embracing this unpredictability through iterative feedback loops drives manufacturing innovation and creates cult objects. The proposed approach involves fusing PC pellets with a screw industrial extruder, using parametric modeling and part redesign to mitigate warping, and employing Adaptive Layer Height slicing to unlock new geometries and reduce scrap.
